output.notes: Visible changes vs previous version: the background was regenerated with the warm charcoal-brown seamless environment - the flat two-tone wall/floor split is gone, replaced by a continuous polished floor with mottled texture, ivory upper-left diffusion and amber bloom wrapping the right side, finally expressing the tobacco-vanille warmth. Contact detail crop [488,1105,1031,1355] confirms the bottle base rests on the floor with a believable darkened contact line and soft reflection beneath the base; grounding is now solid (base_y=1245, within the 91% limit; height_ratio 0.5903 in hero range; no floating, no extra bottles, label matches the original product exactly). Title/product overlap is false on the geometry and visually confirmed - the left text stack stays clear of the bottle. Remaining minor weaknesses: the text stack is still modest in presence versus reference headline typography, and the environment, while much improved, is less sculpturally tactile than the foil/wood/fire references - competent-to-polished level rather than fully resolved campaign artistry, but no unresolved problems.
